description:
Create, list, show and delete person files. People are link targets for note attendees and task assignees. They are not threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files (open only by default)
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Args:
  QUERY: optional fuzzy search; results ranked by similarity.
  PERSON: full name, matching the filename without .md.

Flags:
  list:
    --all  include closed people
    --json  JSON output
  show: --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name  required. Full name; becomes the filename. Must not contain '/' or start with '.'
    --category  required. professional, personal or voluntary
  delete: -y / --yes  required to delete

Examples:
  ["list", "rivera"]
  ["show", "Sam Rivera", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Sam Rivera", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts.
  Files live at people/<Name>.md.
  Create a person before assigning them a task. `tasks` fails on an assignee who has no person file.
  delete is permanent and fails without -y.
  Exit 1: empty or invalid name, file already exists, person not found, or delete without -y.
